title: Add connection duplication action to UI
body:
Adds a Duplicate action to the Connections page in the Airflow UI. The action opens a prefilled connection form using the existing connection's details, while leaving the connection ID and password blank so the user can enter a new ID and credentials before creating the duplicate.

Adds the corresponding English translation for the Duplicate action.
